name: full_bench_short_summaries_vectors
description: A vectorized collection of short summaries for math benchmark items, paired with precomputed embeddings to support retrieval-augmented methods. Designed to evaluate retrieval quality and to provide retrieval priors for downstream math problem solving and RAG pipelines.
evaluation_method: recall_at_k (primary for retrieval) and downstream_exact_match/accuracy for RAG-enhanced solving
general_score_metric: recall@k (primary for retrieval vectors); downstream exact-match when used for QA
reputation: Niche dataset used primarily by the RAG4Math community for retrieval-augmented math experiments; limited broader adoption.
